verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a security-scanning platform, so official SDKs are a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents only a CLI, an MCP server and a REST API for listing deployments, findings and projects. None of these is an official SDK: the API is a developer building block, and the CLI and MCP server belong to other stories. No openapi spec was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
